info.name: Maya Admin Panel - Complete API Collection
info.description:
Comprehensive collection of all Maya Platform Admin APIs (103+ endpoints)

## 🚀 READY TO TEST - NO SETUP REQUIRED!
This collection includes:
- ✅ Realistic request bodies and examples
- ✅ Pre-configured environment variables
- ✅ Sample data for immediate testing
- ✅ Authentication flow with token management

## Features Included:
- 🔐 Authentication (4 endpoints)
- 👥 User Management (10 endpoints) 
- 📅 Booking Management (7 endpoints)
- 💳 Payment Management (8 endpoints)
- ⭐ Review Management (7 endpoints)
- 🎨 Artist Verification (6 endpoints)
- 🚀 Promotions & Marketing (9 endpoints)
- 🎧 Support Management (10 endpoints)
- 📊 Analytics & Reports (8 endpoints)
- ⚙️ System Configuration (9 endpoints)
- 👥 Admin User Management (9 endpoints)

## Quick Start:
1. Import this collection into Postman
2. Run 'Admin Login' to authenticate
3. Start testing any endpoint immediately!

## All Variables Pre-Configured:
- Server URL, credentials, and sample IDs included
- Realistic test data in request bodies
- No external files or database setup needed
